title: Small Business Finance Corporation Amendment Act 1987

sections.shortTitle: Small Business Finance Corporation Amendment Act 1987
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 1987
SMALL BUSINESS
FINANCE CORPORATION
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1987
ACT XIV OF 1987
An Act further to amend the Small Business Finance Corporation Act, 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 16th November, 1987]
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Small Business
Finance Corporation Act, 1972 (XXIX of 1972), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
1. Short title and commencement.----(1) This Act may be called
the Small Business Finance Corporation (Amendment) Act, 1987.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Small Business Finance Corporation Amendment Act 1987
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Act XXIX of 1972

ACT XIV OF 1987
SMALL BUSINESS
FINANCE CORPORATION
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1987
ACT XIV OF 1987
An Act further to amend the Small Business Finance Corporation Act, 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 16th November, 1987]
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Small Business
Finance Corporation Act, 1972 (XXIX of 1972), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
2. Amendment of section 2, Act
XXIX of 1972.------In the Small Business Finance Corporation Act, 1972
(XXIX of 1972), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 2, in
clause (cc), for the words "one million and five hundred thousand
rupees" the words "five million rupees" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Small Business Finance Corporation Amendment Act 1987
sections.description:
Amendment of section 18, Act XXIX of 1972

ACT XIV OF 1987
SMALL BUSINESS
FINANCE CORPORATION
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1987
ACT XIV OF 1987
An Act further to amend the Small Business Finance Corporation Act, 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 16th November, 1987]
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Small Business
Finance Corporation Act, 1972 (XXIX of 1972), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
3. Amendment of section 18,
Act XXIX of 1972.------ In the said Act, in section 18,--
(a) in subsection (1), in clause
(a), for the words "three hundred thousand rupees" the words
"six hundred thousand rupees" shall be substituted; and
(2) in subsection (2),--
(i) for the words "fifty
thousand rupees", twice occurring, the words "five hundred thousand
rupees" shall be substituted: and
(ii) for the provisos the
following shall be substituted, namely:-
"Provided that, in the case of cottage industry, this
subsection shall have effect as if for the words "five hundred thousand
rupees" the words "one million and five hundred thousand rupees"
were substituted.".
